observation.visible_scene: A dance studio with white walls and a full-height mirror wall on the right. A person seen mostly from behind wears a red sleeveless top, a white tutu skirt, red leg warmers, red shoes, and a red-and-white Santa hat with a pom-pom. The mirror shows the front reflection of the same person (smiling) plus the studio ceiling light strip, track spotlights, a wall-mounted AC unit, and a metal folding rack. The camera viewpoint and background fixtures remain fixed across all frames.
visible_changes: The dancer's arms transition from a low/open position (one arm extended sideways, the other bent near the head) progressively upward until both arms are raised high overhead with open hands, holding that elevated position for the latter half of the clip.
The torso and hips rotate slightly, shifting the body from a back-facing stance toward a more side-on orientation relative to the mirror.
The feet and legs reposition: the stance narrows and the weight/foot placement changes, with the legs crossing slightly as the body turns.
The mirror reflection tracks these same movements continuously, confirming it is the same person rather than a second dancer.
outside_clip_unknowns: The beginning and end of the dance routine and whether the arm-raise is part of a larger choreography.
Any music or external cue driving the motion.
uncertain_details: The exact footwork sequence is hard to resolve at this frame rate.
Whether the slight body sway is intentional dance motion or balance adjustment.
